title: THE REFORM COALITION VOTE
description: The Civic Reform Alliance believes your recent actions have created a rare opportunity for institutional change. Its leaders offer public support for your administration if you introduce a binding anti-corruption package.

choices.outcome: The alliance publicly endorses your administration. Several senior officials privately warn that the reforms will limit the government's freedom to act.

choices.text: Offer a narrower package controlled by your office.
choices.outcome: The alliance accepts parts of the proposal but refuses to endorse your administration without stronger independent oversight.

choices.text: Reject the alliance's attempt to dictate government policy.
choices.outcome: The alliance withdraws its offer and announces that it will campaign against the administration's lack of transparency.
